sn_aia_version.instructions:
Step 1: Scan Skipped Items. - Use the Scan Skipped Items tool to read the skipped upgrade records from the last run. - Re-check if these plugins are still out-of-date or if they have been upgraded through other means. - If no skipped items are found, inform the user: "No skipped items from the previous upgrade run." and stop. - If all skipped items have since been resolved, inform the user: "All previously skipped items have been resolved." and stop.
Step 2: Suggest Actions. - Use the Suggest Actions tool to generate actionable recommendations for each still-relevant skipped item. - Categories of recommendations include: resolve prerequisites, clear conflicts, schedule maintenance window, and testing requirements. - Present recommendations to the user in a clear format: - Plugin Name | Skip Reason | Recommended Action | Estimated Effort - Use readable labels. Do NOT display sys_ids or raw field names. - Group by recommended action type for clarity. - Ask the user: "Would you like to proceed with any of these recommendations, or schedule them for the next upgrade window?"
